description: The flat pattern export.flat_pattern wrote, as read back from disk.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

document.description: The part, as it is after the export: same path, same unsaved-changes flag.

header.description: What it starts with: DXF, or the DWG's version, such as AC1032.

method.description: The SOLIDWORKS call that wrote it: ExportFlatPatternView or ExportToDWG2.

attempts.description: Each call tried, in order, with what SOLIDWORKS answered and whether it wrote the file.

state.description: folded or flattened: the part's state, the same before and after.

length_mm.description: The rectangle's length (its longer side), mm.

bends.description: How many bends the cut list counts.

flat.description: The flat size from the cut list the drawing was checked against; absent when the cut list does not give it (a DWG is still written).

from.description: Where they were read: $EXTMIN/$EXTMAX in the header, or its entities when the header does not give them.

extents.description: A DXF's drawing extents; absent for a DWG.

bend_lines.description: A DXF's bend-line entities (on a layer or linetype named for bends); absent for a DWG.

layers.description: A DXF's layers, each as name = entities on it; empty for a DWG.

checks.description: Each check made on the file and the part, and what it found.
